models_evaluated: Vendor-developed pediatric ED sepsis predictive model

links.outcome: Local predictive performance versus vendor-reported performance
links.effect: Model predictive performance dropped from vendor-reported performance when measured locally at 2 pediatric ED sites.
links.quote: Model predictive performance dropped from vendor-reported performance.

links.outcome: Real-world performance of vendor model compared with vendor claims
links.effect: Predictive performance differed substantially from vendor-reported metrics when tailored for real-world use.
links.quote: When tailoring a vendor-developed pediatric ED sepsis model for real-world usage, predictive performance differed substantially.

models_evaluated: Vendor-developed pediatric emergency department sepsis predictive model

links.outcome: Locally observed predictive performance compared with vendor-reported performance
links.effect: Predictive performance dropped from vendor-reported performance; numerical performance estimates were not provided.
links.quote: Model predictive performance dropped from vendor-reported performance.

links.outcome: Mortality, ED-to-ICU admissions, and ICU-free days before versus after implementation
links.effect: 30-day mortality: 6% [45/741] to 4% [52/1114]; ED-to-ICU admissions: 87% [646/741] to 84% [941/1114]; ICU-free days: 6 to 5; none statistically significant.
links.quote: Decreases in 30-day mortality (6% [45/741] to 4% [52/1114]); ED to ICU admissions (87% [646/741] to 84% [941/1114]), and ICU free days (6 to 5) after the intervention did not meet statistical significance.

links.effect: Predictive performance in the local setting was lower than what the vendor reported.
links.quote: Model predictive performance dropped from vendor-reported performance.

links.effect: Time to first antibiotic decreased from 112 to 102 minutes and time to first bolus decreased by 16.7 minutes after intervention.
links.quote: Mean time to first antibiotic decreased from 112 to 102 minutes (P = .05, 95% confidence interval of difference, -19.1 to 0.1) and time to first bolus decreased by 16.7 minutes (P = .03, 95% confidence interval difference, -31.8 to -1.5) after the intervention.
